note: Curated download catalog for a 12-32GB-VRAM home-hardware box, aimed at coding + generative work (logic, financial/marketing prose, analysis, documents, and code-driven charts/widgets/artifacts). One canonical entry per distinct model (dense and MoE both) — quant/imatrix/distill/MTP re-quant variants are intentionally excluded; search Hugging Face directly for those. Source of truth for docs/candidate-models.md. approxWeightsBytes is the on-disk GGUF size at the listed quant (raw bytes, GiB-based, approximate); real KV/context fit must still be measured with `npm run calibrate`. Repos/files verified against public GGUF releases as of 2026-07; confirm the exact file before downloading.

models.name: Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct
models.why: Best local coder in this footprint; excellent self-contained HTML/React artifacts and chart code. Q4_K_M leaves ample VRAM for a large context window.

models.name: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct
models.why: Coder-tuned MoE — very fast on a 32GB GPU because only ~3B params are active. Strong at tool-use and iterating on widgets/artifacts.

models.name: Qwen3-32B
models.why: Strongest all-round open model in this class for reasoning + code + structured prose. Thinking model — run `npm run sweep` to cap the reasoning budget before trusting it for documents/charts.

models.name: Qwen3-30B-A3B
models.why: Fast MoE daily driver — ~3B active means high tokens/sec on this GPU. Thinking model; cap the reasoning budget with `npm run sweep`.

models.name: Qwen3.6-27B
models.why: Newest Qwen generation with multi-token prediction and vision — a top all-rounder in this footprint. Measured KV ~40KB/token; fits a large context on a 32GB GPU at Q5_K_M. Thinking model; cap the budget with `npm run sweep`. (Community distill/imatrix/pi-tune spins of this model exist on HF — this is the canonical base.)

models.name: Gemma-3-27B-it
models.why: Best-in-class prose/tone for marketing & financial writing; multimodal so it can read charts/images. Note the higher per-token KV — measure context fit with calibrate.

models.name: Gemma-4-31B-it
models.why: Newer Gemma generation — dense 31B with vision, strong prose/tone and document reading. High per-token KV (measured ~52KB/token); measure context fit with `npm run calibrate` before pushing context.

models.name: Mistral-Small-3.2-24B-Instruct
models.why: Fast, no forced 'thinking' tax, superb instruction-following. Reliable for document/JSON generation and structured output.

models.name: Ornith-1.0-35B
models.why: Vision-capable 35B MoE (deepreinforce-ai). Largest model here — Q4_K_S keeps weights near ~19GB so a 32GB GPU still has KV headroom. Thinking model; cap the budget with `npm run sweep`. (MTP-APEX / NVFP4 re-quant spins exist on HF — this is the canonical base.)

models.name: GLM-4-32B-0414
models.why: Notably strong at single-file front-end web artifacts and interactive widgets.

models.name: GLM-4.7-Flash
models.why: Strongest model in the 30B-A3B class — leads SWE-Bench/GPQA at this size with a 200K window and ~3.6B active params (fast on a 32GB GPU). Zhipu ships weights only, so unsloth is the canonical GGUF source. Thinking model; cap the budget with `npm run sweep`.

models.name: Codestral-22B-v0.1
models.why: Strong, fast, permissive fill-in-the-middle for editor-style completion workflows.

models.name: NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B
models.why: NVIDIA's 30B-A3B MoE reasoner. ~3B active keeps it fast; NVIDIA advertises a very long context ceiling — confirm the exact max before relying on 1M. Thinking model; cap the budget with `npm run sweep`.

models.name: gpt-oss-20B
models.why: OpenAI's open-weight 20B MoE — cleanest tool-call output in the class and native MXFP4 (~11GB), leaving the most KV/context headroom of any model here. Built-in reasoning-effort levels.

models.name: Phi-4 (14B)
models.why: Punches above its weight on structured reasoning/analysis. Q8_0 fits easily and leaves the most VRAM of any pick for a large context window.

models.name: DeepSeek-OCR-2
models.why: Document/PDF ingestion companion — small enough (~3GB at Q8_0) to ride alongside any other model. NOTE: current GGUFs need a specific llama.cpp PR branch, not upstream main — confirm runtime support before pulling.
